Sandbox_AchievementFramework_BrowserHotk: Key code that opens the character Achievements tab (claim/progress). (default is 36, the J key). Authoring Browser is only via Open Achievement Browser on this page (debug/admin).
Sandbox_AchievementFramework_DebugLog_to: When ON: write AF_debug.log and counter dumps more often. Leave OFF for normal play (better performance).
